notes.title: Day 1 Update
notes.notes:
- Added Custom music info in custom music menu. There is link to discord where you can find Custom music channel for everything you need to make your own custom music.

- Added “Darkness” text and sound when entering in a room with darkness mechanic.

- Fixed visual bug when having more than 1000 ammo.

- Disabled metronome track in song selection.

- Changed map default button to tab from M

- Fixed issue where reload text was wrapping in some languages

- Fixed selecting sound in loot sound played multiple times causing it to be louder than intended when using a mouse

notes.title: Doubled Passive Items! (well, almost)
notes.notes:
The patch adds 32 new passive items with awesome synergies, almost doubling the item pool! Find your own favorite combos and builds!

[list]
[*] [b]Auto Stun:[/b] When hit if you have a stun automatically use it instead of taking damage.
[*] [b]Execution Inspiration:[/b] Gain a Freestyle charge on Finisher.
[*] [b]Freestyle Rehash:[/b] 33% chance to not consume a Freestyle charge.
[*] [b]Ricocheting Rounds:[/b] 10% on hit to richochet the bullet to a random nearby target.
[*] [b]Holster Charger:[/b] Every 5 shots with the same weapon charge the next shot of your holstered weapons, dealing 200% more damage and using no ammo.
[*] [b]Corrosive Clip:[/b] Reloading an empty weapon throws the clip at a nearby enemy and applies two stacks of Corrosion to it.
[*] [b]Reflecting Dash:[/b] Reflect enemy projectiles hit by your dash back to the direction they came from.
[*] [b]High Value Returns:[/b] Upon entering a new Depth, gain additional Tickets equal to 20% of your current Tickets.
[*] [b]Pain Inspiration:[/b] Gain maximum Freestyle charges whenever you take damage.
[*] [b]No Pain No Gain:[/b] Gain 10 tickets whenever you take damage.
[*] [b]Combat Inspiration:[/b] Gain two Freestyle charges whenever you enter a combat room for the first time.
[*] [b]Expiration Launcher:[/b] 30% on kill to launch a missile from the killed enemy's corpse.
[*] [b]Trigger Launcher:[/b] 10% chance on shoot to launch a missile to a random nearby target.
[*] [b]Multi Shot:[/b] 10% chance on shoot to shoot once from each of your holstered weapons.
[*] [b]Repeating Shot:[/b] 10% chance on shoot to shoot once more without consuming ammo after half of a beat. Can trigger itself.
[*] [b]Mini Fridge:[/b] 10% chance on shoot to toss out a Mini Fridge that applies a stack of Chill to enemies around it every beat.
[*] [b]Fiery Explosions:[/b] Explosions caused by you apply Burn to enemies.
[*] [b]Caustic Demise:[/b] When an enemy dies it spreads any active Corrosion effects to nearby enemies.
[*] [b]Luck Manipulation:[/b] Your on hit, on shoot and on kill effects are rolled one additional time if the initial roll wasn't successful.
[*] [b]Corrosive Rounds:[/b] 10% chance on hit to apply a stack of Corrosion to the target.
[*] [b]Incapacitating Rounds: [/b]5% chance on hit to Stun the target for four beats.
[*] [b]Thermal Shock:[/b] Call down a Lightning Strike when Burn is applied to a Chilled enemy or other way around.
[*] [b]Freezing Cold:[/b] Triggering Chill on a target with three stacks of Chill Freezes it.
[*] [b]Chilling Dash:[/b] Add a stack of Chill to each enemy hit by your dash.
[*] [b]Fan the Flames:[/b] Doubles the amount of damage dealt by Burn.
[*] [b]Firespreader:[/b] Burn spreads from enemies to other nearby enemies.
[*] [b]Heatwave:[/b] Set enemies around you on fire every four beats.
[*] [b]Status Overload:[/b] Hits deal 20% more damage per unique status effect on the target.
[*] [b]Chilling Rounds:[/b] 10% chance on hit to apply a stack of Chill to the target.
[*] [b]Reloading Finisher:[/b] Reload your weapon automatically whenever you finish an enemy.
[*] [b]Death Mark:[/b] Mark enemies on hit. Deals damage to marked enemies after four beats.
[*] [b]Incendiary Ammunition:[/b] 10% chance on hit to lit the target on fire. 
[/list]

The patch also adds various bug fixes and graphical improvements.

notes.title: Leaderboards and Other Improvements
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added in-game leaderboards.
[*] Adjusted internal wall visuals and x-ray effect to make walls more readable.
[*]Missing the beat when reloading was punished by long reload time. It disrupted the gameplay flow so we changed that mechanic:

[list]
[*]Reloading happens now always instantly even when reloading offbeat.
[*]When reloading to the beat, you will get special ammo that deals double damage.
[*]All weapon damages are adjusted to this change, so when playing to the beat, the balancing stays the same.
[/list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused players to get stuck on level 3.
[*] Fixed various smaller issues.
[/list]

notes.title: 'Beat the Boss' competition
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44886475/13f333f825e79291d5d0b02674d09f79d1c65398.png[/img]
The ‘[b]Beat the Boss[/b]’ competition is an event on [b]August 4th, 2024[/b], where participants compete against the CEO of Kalma Games, Atte-Petteri Ronkanen. Participants will have 24h to set their highest score with unlimited tries. After the competition, Atte will livestream his one and only try to set his score. Everyone who gets a higher score than Atte is a winner!

The competition will use the Hard Mode difficulty, and will be pre-seeded, meaning that the run is identical for everyone. Only skill matters!

[b]Prize:[/b] Steam key for the full game. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3104040/KILLBEAT_Demo/ style=button]Play the Demo[/url]

[b]Additionally:[/b] All registered participants who didn't win are automatically entered into a raffle for 10 participation prize keys!

Further details and the registration will be available through the in-game menu of the demo, or below:

[url=https://forms.gle/68e9pEBmr5ScKyPZ7 style=button]Register now and BEAT THE BOSS[/url]

notes.title: KILLBEAT demo OUT NOW
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=yDEXXzMOFVs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]KILLBEAT[/b] demo is out now, and we couldn’t be more happy about it! [/h3]

The demo contains the first biome of the game, called “Fallen Forest”, and showcases the core mechanics of the game. The full release will have a total of five biomes, the derelict amusement park HUB, lots and lots of items, and branching storylines to make each run play different. Furthermore, you will be able to kill to your own beat with the custom music feature! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3104040/KILLBEAT_Demo/ style=button]Play the Demo[/url]

Once you’ve experienced the demo, please write down any and all insights you might have - we would love to hear your thoughts to help us develop KILLBEAT to be the best experience we can. The same link can be found in the in-game menu of the demo.

[url=https://forms.gle/sWV5wKfFMSQMvqCJA style=button]Share Demo Feedback[/url]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2808530/KILLBEAT/
